input.title: BUG: Series arithmetic ops with PyArrow dtypes and scalars can upcast
input.body:
Ref: https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/56021#issuecomment-5797277066

Reproducer:

```python
s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3], dtype="int32[pyarrow]")
print((s + 1).dtype)             # int64[pyarrow]
print((s * 2).dtype)             # int64[pyarrow]
print((s + np.int32(1)).dtype)   # int64[pyarrow]
print((s + s[0]).dtype)          # int64[pyarrow]

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3], dtype="float[pyarrow]")
print((s + 1.5).dtype)             # double[pyarrow]
print((s * 1.5).dtype)             # double[pyarrow]
print((s + np.float32(1.5)).dtype) # double[pyarrow]
print((s + s[0]).dtype)            # double[pyarrow]

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3], dtype=pd.ArrowDtype(pa.decimal128(10, 2)))
print((s + 1).dtype)   # decimal128(22, 2)[pyarrow]
print((s * 2).dtype)   # decimal128(30, 2)[pyarrow]
```
